paper.title: Lattice Convolutional Networks for Learning Ground States of Quantum Many-Body Systems
paper.authors: Cong Fu, Xuan Zhang, Huixin Zhang, Hongyi Ling, Shenglong Xu, Shuiwang Ji

results.system_description: 6x6 triangular lattice, periodic along both primitive vectors; J = 1; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Table on p. 8 (row Triangular, size 36, J2 = 0, column 'LCN (ours)')
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the LCN state; the GNN columns are other learned ansätze from the same table and the reference column is ED.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 6 × 6 · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.source_location: Table "Estimated energy per site of the learned wave function" (tab:result), row Square, size 36, J2 = 0, column "LCN (ours)"
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the LCN state estimated from 200,000 configurations of equilibrated Markov chains, with the error from 100 bins (Sec. Experiments, Setup); the GNN columns and the reference column are other calculations.
results.notes: Lattices and periodic boundaries are those of Kochkov et al. (arXiv:2110.06390, Appendix A.5.a), as stated in Sec. Experiments; spin-1/2 operators, J1 = 1. The magnetization sector is not stated.
